title: Digital Readiness Maturity Levels
subtitle: DigiMitra classifies businesses into 4 structured stages (RBDL Levels 0–3):

level_0.name: Level 0: Non-Digital / Traditional
level_0.desc: Manual paper records, cash-only transactions, no active digital footprint.

level_1.name: Level 1: Basic Digital Presence
level_1.desc: UPI/QR payments, WhatsApp Business, basic Google business listing.

level_2.name: Level 2: Operational Digitalization
level_2.desc: Digital billing & bookkeeping (Tally/Vyapar), inventory tracking, social commerce.

level_3.name: Level 3: Integrated Digital Enterprise
level_3.desc: Automated workflows, integrated ERP/CRM, multi-channel sales and data analytics.
